kind: Portable, lossless API corpus handoff; proposal only; not FE acceptance or dispatch

interpretation.apiInputVsStored: First actual item GET is the UI comparison baseline. Null/absent evidence collection on create normalizes to [], required/product text trims, selected optional text trims to null, timestamps may normalize offsets. No API hardening/coercion or weakened enum/owner-contract validation.
interpretation.freshConnectedChain: Fresh real API create/read -> actual Razor -> production form.js -> ordered FormData -> actual MVC binding/ToPayload -> existing Gateway route -> actual API/store -> reread. Never seed archived snapshots directly or supply canned HTTP success.
interpretation.timeComparison: Preserve exact timestamp strings as data; compare 100ns UTC ticks via .NET/BigInt/decimal-string-safe code, never JS Number/Date precision.
interpretation.identity: Archived actual draft ids/versions are evidence only. Replay uses newly created id/version from its real GET, without changing any stored data.
interpretation.access: No authorization token or HTTP header value is included.
